coordinate_system.semantics: DF native coordinates preserved verbatim. Loot cs2_position uses authorized approximate XY and assumed .01 Z scale with statistical offset; no floor snapping.
coordinate_system.original_semantics: First two horizontal map coordinates; third elevation. Likely UE centimeters, but axis ordering/units not independently calibrated. Not CS2-ready.

cs2_transform.applied_to: 247 active loot entries only; excluded_loot, extraction_markers and power_switches unchanged
cs2_transform.horizontal_choice: Compiled-origin .01 axis-swap hypothesis in calibration.json horizontal_report; also used by the statistical-Z candidate. Measured least-squares similarity was not substituted because floor diagnostics used these exact XY columns.
cs2_transform.z_offset_method: Global offset search -400..800 at .1; maximize equal-item training support within2; median-refine <=2-unit consensus. No nearest-below before offset.
cs2_transform.authorization: Statistical Z uses an assumed uniform .01 scale and offset; no snapping, all 247 entries retained including 24 flagged outliers.
cs2_transform.rotation_and_asset_pivots: Not calibrated; source null rotation retained. Model mapping is user-selected, not original actor subtype evidence.
